entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: You want me to let Futaba help out[n]around the shop?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: But I've never had her do anything like[n]that before. Is she gonna be okay?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Still, putting her out in front of customers[n]is a little much...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: This isn't the same as taking care of a cat,[n]you know?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: D-Don't worry. I did graduate middle[n]school last year...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I-I'll be fine if I just think of this as my[n]first summer job of high school!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Well in that case... how about you wash[n]the dishes?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Just don't push yourself too hard, okay?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: ...Keep an eye on Futaba for me.

entries.speaker: Pompous Customer
entries.en: Man, smooth as always. What number[n]Bond girl is this, Boss?

entries.speaker: Pompous Customer
entries.en: You usually go for the older ones, right?[n]It's only natural you'd want someone[n]younger sometimes.

entries.speaker: Pompous Customer
entries.en: It's like the Guatemala Peaberry coffee.[n]Its acidic sweetness is akin to a breath of[n]fresh air.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Sorry, we're serving a blend today.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Hey, snap out of it. Hurry up and bring[n]him the coffee before it gets cold.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: When in the world did she...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Hey, Futaba. Haven't I told you not to[n]show up in front of people with that[n]damn thing on?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: And be more polite when you're bringing[n]something to a customer.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Did you see!? I did my job right!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Huh. Turns out this is pretty easy.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: But it, um, protects me from the steam!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: To think Futaba'd go out and talk to[n]a customer herself... Mask aside, I'm[n]impressed.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Looks like people really can change.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Sojiro! Want me to bring coffee to more[n]customers?
